title: XP OS (Portfolio)
description: A retro Windows XP-inspired portfolio built entirely without UI frameworks to deepen my understanding of vanilla Javascript, CSS structure, and DOM manipulation.
status: Implementing a dynamic Markdown fetching system. Just fixed a code readability issue in light mode. Next plan: building this interactive File Explorer for the Projects page!

title: Cozy-MyPhotoGallery
description: I created Cozy-MyPhotoGallery to store my best photography work, with a cozy design inspired by the layout and aesthetics of the Yuru Camp website. Technically, it is a dynamic gallery engine that consumes structured JSON data to render grids efficiently. This project strengthened my understanding of DOM manipulation, dynamic data rendering, and responsive client-side design.

title: Spotify App Redesign
description: A modern and sleek redesign of the Spotify mobile interface, focusing on improved navigation and a vibrant green aesthetic.

title: Monitoring Dana Desa
description: Sistem informasi pemantauan alokasi dan penggunaan Dana Desa berbasis web, dirancang untuk transparansi dan akuntabilitas data.

title: TechCorner Headless CMS
description: A custom headless CMS engine designed specifically to manage contents for my personal portfolio. Built with HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JS, integrated with Supabase Auth for session handling, PostgreSQL database for persistent storage, client-side caching (SessionStorage) for performance optimization, and DOMPurify for sanitizing markdown input previews.

title: Personal Training Platform
description: Learning to code on a single monitor was incredibly frustrating I constantly had to Alt-Tab between reading theory and writing code in my editor. To solve this friction, I develop an E-Learning platform inspired by freeCodeCamp, but specifically designed to eliminate context switching. By integrating an industry-standard curriculum alongside a live code editor in a single, unified workspace, my goal is to keep learners deeply focused and in the flow state.
